Not only does [[Wioslea]] have a great deploy to power ratio, she has a destiny of 5 which fits right into an insert based deck. Deploy her at the [[Cloud City: Incinerator]] and couple her with [[Spaceport Speeders]] and an [[R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo)]] and you have a great combination which allows you to activate a lot of Force without losing any cards. Place her in a [[Cloud City Sabacc]] based deck and you have a gambler and a great draw during Sabacc games.

Combos:

[[Wioslea]] + [[Cloud City Sabacc]] - to help you win Sabacc games!

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the stat boxes and the deploy and forfeit numbers) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-wioslea-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Wioslea]]: The game text changes: “Where present, during” becomes “During”; “unoccupied transport” is added after “target an opponent's”; “for 'purchase.'” becomes “present.”; “'pay' (use)” becomes “use”; “number and take target.” becomes “cost to 'purchase' target (use as if stolen).”. The slip shows only the lower part of the card and adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Wioslea” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
